sources.hull.massWithoutSail: Day 2017 p8 (PDF page 8): 79.5 kg measured without sail.
sources.hull.cgAboveDeck: Day 2017 p8: CG 12 cm above the deck at the forward end of the cockpit.
sources.hull.depthDeckToKeel: WEB SOURCE, not in docs/: owner measurement 375 mm, deepest section just forward of the mast. https://sailingforums.com/threads/depth-of-laser-from-top-deck-to-bottom-most-point.36909/
sources.hull.table2: Day 2017 p7, Table 2, 'Level trim 160 kg' row (from page image).
sources.hull.kbBelowWaterlineFracOfTc: TUNING GUESS: depth of centre of buoyancy below the waterline as a fraction of canoe-body draft.
sources.hull.crossflowCd: TUNING GUESS: hull drag coefficient for pure sideways motion on the lateral area Lwl x Tc.
sources.hull.topsidesCd: TUNING GUESS: Day 2017 Eq. 7 (p5) gives topsides areas but no drag coefficient was found in docs/.
sources.hull.uprightDragArea: Day 2017 p7, Fig. 2, 'Level Trim 80kg' tank data (160 kg all-up, bare hull, upright). APPROXIMATE: read off the plot at 300 dpi, about +/-0.0002 m^2.
sources.hull.uprightDragAreaDayDelft: Day 2017 p7, Fig. 2, 'Delft level Trim 80kg' (Day's own Delft prediction). Cross-check only, not used by the sim. APPROXIMATE, read off the plot.
sources.hull.frictionLengthFrac: Larsson & Eliasson p64 (PDF p80), Fig 5.8: hull Reynolds number on 0.7 Lwl.
sources.hull.residuaryBlendFn/residuaryBlendExpo: TUNING GUESS: below Fn 0.15 (the lowest Fn in the Keuning & Katgert table) the residuary resistance is R(0.15) (Fn/0.15)^2, so it goes to zero with speed.
sources.rig.luff/foot: ILCA class rules p36, G.3.3 ILCA 7 MKI sail: luff max 5130 mm, foot max 2740 mm.
sources.rig.ceHeightFracOfLuff/ceAftFracOfFoot/m: Day 2017 p4, section 2.1: CE 36.4% of luff above boom, 33% of foot aft of luff, 11 deg equivalent rake at CE height (Day applies the rake upwind only).
sources.rig.gooseneckAboveMastButt: ILCA class rules p33, F.6.2: lowest part of gooseneck fitting 945 +/- 5 mm from the lower mast butt.
sources.rig.mastButtBelowDeck: TUNING GUESS: assumes the mast tube reaches the hull bottom (hull depth 0.375 m, web source above).
sources.rig.mastXFromTransom: TUNING GUESS: [INFERENCE] the oval symbol on the ILCA hull fittings diagram D.4.3 (p27) at 2903-2947 mm from the hull datum point is read as the mast step. The diagram is 'only a guide'.
sources.rig.mastDiameter: WEB SOURCE, not in docs/: standard lower mast 63.5 mm. https://sailingforums.com/threads/mast-step-dimensions-and-repair.15632/
sources.rig.bareMastCd/sleeveMastCd: Day 2017 p5, section 2.5: bare mast Cd 0.8, mast inside the sail sleeve 0.15 (upwind only; downwind it acts as part of the sail).
sources.rig.effectiveSpanFactor: TUNING GUESS: form heff = cheff * (mainsail head height above sheer + freeboard) from ORC VPP Documentation 2023 Eq. 5.43-5.45 (https://orc.org/uploads/files/ORC-VPP-Documentation-2023.pdf, p54); cheff for a una rig is not given there.
sources.rig.luffStartBetaEffDeg/luffFullBetaEffD: TUNING GUESS: best-trim envelope falloff (PHYSICS.md L2 design decision). luffAmount ramps from 0 at an equivalent apparent wind angle of luffStart to 1 at luffFull. Milestone 2: luffStart 12 -> 24 (luffing below about AWA 24; Day 2017 p11 reports VPP upwind AWA of 27-33 deg), luffFull 0 -> 16 (luffing band 8 deg wide). stallWidth 15 unchanged: 8 and 25 give an identical polar because the sheet search never over-sheets.
sources.crew.mass/height: Day 2017 p7 '80 kg/1.83 m sailor'. A parameter, not a constant (PHYSICS.md [tune]).
sources.crew.cgHeightFrac: Day 2017 p7, section 4: crew CG at 55% of standing height.
sources.crew.hikeReachFrac: Day 2017 p8: crew CG at most 95% of its standing CG height out from the centreline when hiking.
sources.crew.sitInOffset/sitInZAboveHullCg/hiked: TUNING GUESS: Day 2017 p8 says the hiked crew CG is 'the lowest value possible' relative to the boat CG but gives no number. Milestone 2: sitInOffset 0.55 -> 0.35 m (sailor can sit inboard of the side deck); 0.55 forced 18-20 deg of windward heel downwind and 4 deg upwind at 6 kn.
sources.crew.dubois/frontalAreaFrac/sideAreaFrac: Day 2017 p5, section 2.5, Eqs. 8-9 and text (W in newtons, H in metres).
sources.daggerboard.span/chord/thickness: ILCA class rules p28, E.3: board max 680 (leading edge, keel line to tip) x 341 chord, max thickness 33 mm. Rectangular planform with R=60 tip ignored.
sources.daggerboard.sweepDeg/taperRatio: TUNING GUESS: drawing on p28 is rotated; board treated as unswept and untapered.
sources.daggerboard.leadingEdgeXFromTransom: TUNING GUESS: [INFERENCE] ILCA D.4.3 (p27) marker at 2426-2538 mm from the hull datum point is read as the forward end of the daggerboard slot.
sources.daggerboard.cpDepthFrac/cpChordFrac: Day 2017 p7, section 3.3: centre of pressure on the quarter chord at 43% of the foil draft.
sources.rudder.span: TUNING GUESS: ILCA p28 trailing edge max 527 mm taken as the immersed span; the rudder drawing is ambiguous (docs/INDEX.md).
sources.rudder.chord/thickness: ILCA class rules p28: chord 203 mm, max thickness 20 mm.
sources.rudder.inflowFactor: Day 2017 p7: rudder inflow speed 0.9 x boat speed.
sources.foil.clMax: Larsson & Eliasson p102 (PDF p118), Fig 6.6: CL max about 1.15-1.3 for AR_e 2-3. APPROXIMATE, read off the plot.
sources.foil.formFactorK: TUNING GUESS: Larsson & Eliasson p65 (PDF p81) puts viscous pressure resistance at 5-10% of friction for hulls; used for the foils too.
sources.foil.downwashA0: TUNING GUESS: Day 2017 p6 gives the downwash form Phi = a0 sqrt(CL_k / AR_eff_k) but not a0. 0.18 chosen so that Phi matches the lifting-line far-wake value 2 CL/(pi AR) at CL=0.3, AR=4.
sources.foil.postStallCdMax: TUNING GUESS: post-stall pressure drag coefficient at 90 deg incidence.
sources.dynamics.*: TUNING GUESS: added masses, inertias, damping and heel limit are not given in docs/.
sources.visual: Render-only geometry (milestone 3). Not used by sim/.
sources.visual.hullSections.deckHalfBeamFrac: Deck half-beam as a fraction of beam/2, read off the hull outline in the ILCA hull fittings diagram D.4.3 (docs/ilca-class-rules.pdf p27) at 250 dpi. APPROXIMATE: the diagram is 'only a guide' and its overall width is about 2.5% wider than 1.37 m relative to its length, so values are normalised to its own maximum (at 38% of LOA from the transom).
sources.visual.hullSections.keelZ/sheerZ: VISUAL ESTIMATE, constrained to: canoe-body draft Tc 0.094 m (Day Table 2), transom just touching the waterline (Day 2017 p6, level trim), waterline ending at Lwl 3.81 m from the transom (keelZ 0 at xFrac 0.90), hull depth 0.375 m just forward of the mast (web source, see hull.depthDeckToKeel) and freeboard 0.28 m at the deepest section. Checked (milestone 3): the lofted hull gives Bwl 1.116 m (sim 1.109), Cm 0.765 (Day Table 2: 0.757), Cp 0.559 (0.552) and a displaced volume 7% above the sim's.
sources.visual.hullSections.bilgeExponent: VISUAL ESTIMATE: superellipse exponent of each half-section (2 = ellipse, larger = boxier). 2.8 at the widest stations makes the lofted waterline beam about 0.81 of the deck beam, close to Bwl/beam = 1.109/1.37 from Day Table 2.
sources.visual.cockpit.foreFromTransom/aftFromTr: Read off the ILCA hull fittings diagram D.4.3 (p27), APPROXIMATE (diagram is 'only a guide').
sources.visual.mast.lowerLength/upperLength/uppe: ILCA class rules p33: ILCA 7 lower mast max 2865, upper mast max 3600 with collar 305 +/- 5 from its lower end (taken as the insertion depth), lowest vang tang fitting min 445 from the butt.
sources.visual.boom.endBlockFromAft/midBlockFrom: ILCA class rules p34, F.6.5: boom end block eye 71 +/- 12 from the aft end, mid boom block 1653 +/- 12 from the aft end, vang fitting aftermost part max 482 from the front.
sources.visual.sail.leech/leechFracs/widths: ILCA class rules p36, G.3.3 ILCA 7 MKI: leech max 5570; widths luff-to-leech at 1/4, 1/2 and 3/4 leech max 2330, 1720, 965.
sources.visual.sail.headWidth/camberDepthFrac/ca: VISUAL ESTIMATE (static placeholder until the cloth sail).
sources.visual.daggerboard: VISUAL ESTIMATE for the part above the keel line and the tip radius; ILCA p28 shows R=60 at the tip.
sources.visual.rudder.tipRadius/leadingEdgeRakeD: ILCA class rules p28: R=60 tip; max 78 deg between leading edge and rudder head bottom (C.8.3.1(b), p12), drawn as a 12 deg rake. The drawing is ambiguous (INDEX.md), so APPROXIMATE.
sources.visual.rudder.stockAftOfTransom/headHeig: VISUAL ESTIMATE: tiller and extension are unrestricted by the class rules (C.8.4).
sources.visual.sailor: VISUAL ESTIMATE: eye position sitting on the side deck at the aft end of the cockpit and when fully hiked, arm segment lengths and hand reach for a 1.83 m sailor.
